name: LoveRush
author: Stephane Cote (Vampirics); Arduboy2 library by Scott Allen and contributors
license: MIT (game); BSD-3-Clause (Arduboy2 library and NucleoOS shim)
description: LoveRush by Vampirics: an endless shoot 'em up. Collect hearts to build up your shields and shoot the angry faces rushing at you; every 15 hearts give an extra shield and the speed grows with your score.

descriptions.en: LoveRush by Vampirics: an endless shoot 'em up. Collect hearts to build up your shields and shoot the angry faces rushing at you; every 15 hearts give an extra shield and the speed grows with your score.
descriptions.it: LoveRush di Vampirics: uno sparatutto infinito. Raccogli i cuori per rinforzare gli scudi e colpisci le facce arrabbiate che ti corrono incontro; ogni 15 cuori guadagni uno scudo e la velocità cresce con il punteggio.
